_about: Companies excluded as China-exposed. Rule: headquartered in China/Hong Kong/Macau (checked automatically), OR Greater China is roughly 15% or more of revenue per recent annual reports, OR major operations in China/Macau. Revenue shares are approximate and should be reviewed against each company's latest 10-K. Edit this file to add or remove names. Names outside the S&P 500 (tickers with a suffix such as .L, .AX, .DE, .PA) were added from memory in Nov 2026 and are the least checked.
